wrong.why: The Azmaveth identified as father of Jeziel and Pelet is azmaveth-6, not the separately recorded son of Jehoadda, azmaveth-2.
The Hebrew calls Jeziel and Pelet sons of Azmaveth, whose matching record is azmaveth-6.
The Hebrew lists Obadiah as second and Eliab as third among the warriors, without stating descent between them.
